Diwali train rush at Delhi Railway Station! From platform ticket restrictions and heavy crowds to long waiting hours and overcrowded general coaches, passengers share their struggles to reach home for Diwali. Watch this ground report on the situation at Indian Railways.
Khabargaon is a modern-day digital platform that helps you travel through current affairs, explainers, ground reports, interviews and unique video shows. Stay tuned for more and more!
